# GRYND
> GRYND is a competitive, one-versus-one Klondike Solitaire site. Two real players get the same deal and race to finish it, and results feed a server-verified ranking. GRYND is 18+ only and promotes responsible play.

GRYND ships one game: Solitaire Duel. It is played in the browser against another person, on the same deterministic deal, with ranked, versus-AI, daily and puzzle modes. Outcomes are decided by the decisions a player makes with the cards they are dealt.

## Solitaire
- [Solitaire Duel](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/games/solitaire-duel): The competitive Klondike race, with the rules, scoring, strategy and FAQ
- [Game Hub](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/games): Every way to play Solitaire on GRYND
- [Ranked](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/play/ranked): Race a real player on the same deal for rating and trophies
- [Play vs AI](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/play/ai): Unrated practice against the built-in bot, at a difficulty you choose
- [Daily Challenge](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/daily): One full deal every UTC day, identical for every player
- [Daily Puzzle](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/play/daily-puzzle): A fresh Solitaire puzzle each day
- [Unlimited Puzzles](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/play/unlimited-puzzles): Practice puzzles with no daily limit
- [Solo Solitaire](https://www.grynd.dedyn.io/solitaire): Play Klondike on your own, no opponent needed
